title: Large subject with Done, Snooze, Remind, ⋯ and previous/next on the title row
steps: Launch Mail with -UseFakeData; open a conversation (Return)
Look at the title area, then click the up and down arrows at the right of the subject
Open the ⋯ menu beside the subject
Open a conversation with a long subject
expected: The subject is large (26 pt). Check mark, clock, bell, ⋯, a small gap, then up and down arrows sit right-aligned on the subject's line; the arrows open the previous and next conversation (K, J). Label and Trash are in ⋯. Under the subject: 'N messages · names' and labels; with AI on the summary still ends 16 pt above the first message. A long subject wraps and the buttons take their own row.
